SILT#00025: In Tauri, if you need a simple downloading system, use the Upload Plugin. Despite the name, it is also able to download and provides a way to monitor progress by giving you the bytes received (progress), progress amount, total amount, and the speed. Find it at https://v2.tauri.app/plugin/upload/
